Welcome to the Build a Panel learning path that shows you how to add a panel to a Grafana dashboard, select a data source, write a query, and view the results.

Panels are the building blocks of Grafana dashboards. Each panel combines a query with a visualization to display your data. This path walks you through creating your first panel from scratch using the built-in Grafana data source.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Add a new panel to any Grafana dashboard
- Select a data source and write a query
- View query results in your panel

## Before you begin

Before you build a panel, ensure you have:

- A Grafana Cloud account. To create one, refer to [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/signup/cloud/connect-account).
- At least one dashboard (it can be empty)
- Basic familiarity with the Grafana interface

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

We understand you might want to explore other capabilities not strictly on this path. We'll provide you opportunities where it makes sense.
